column1: # OCR test screenshots, downloaded at build time (task downloadTestScreenshots), pinned by SHA-256.
# Columns: file, url, sha256, game id (games/<id>.yaml), language, expected opponents top to bottom ("+"-separated,
# empty = no name may be found; "moves:..." = the damaging moves of a move list, see MoveReaderTest).
# Screenshots of fan wikis (© Nintendo / Game Freak / The Pokémon Company) are only downloaded, never committed.
# Wiki files are labelled by generation, not version: where the version is unknown the screenshot is filed under a
# game of that generation with the same battle screen.
